scope: Greece medical discovery — Aristotle University of Thessaloniki School of Medicine

institution.canonicalName: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki School of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: Aristotle University School of Medicine publishes a six-year English medical degree for foreign citizens, with 360 ECTS, 83 modules and seven clinical traineeships.
Clinical rotations begin in year four and the final year includes supervised full-time clinical training at affiliated hospitals.

The official admissions page gives EUR 12,000 annual tuition, two instalments, and requires foreign secondary education, English evidence, a personal statement, interview and admission test or specified test/qualification exemption.
Greece's official Study in Greece programme listing independently describes the programme as a six-year English Medical Degree at Aristotle University with EUR 12,000 tuition.

holdReasons: No independent programme-accreditation/quality-authority record was established in this batch. The school's claim of institutional quality compliance is not sufficient for the required recognition badges without a regulator source.
The reviewed official admissions page gives requirements and tuition but no clearly dated 2026/27 application deadline or class-start/intake date.
No authoritative accommodation, living-cost or international-student support evidence bundle was completed at the required depth.
nextAction: Verify current Hellenic quality/accreditation status for the English Medicine degree and obtain a dated 2026/27 admissions calendar plus official housing/support evidence before packaging.
